actions.action_text: Initiate cap mechanism engineering review with packaging supplier; spec requirements: click-shut closure, leak-proof seal, tactile quality matching Nivea/Adidas benchmark. Request 3 prototype options by end of review period.
actions.context_for_team: Customer explicitly compared cap unfavorably to Nivea and Adidas ('Wildstone ka cap weak lagta hai'). Has experienced actual leakage in gym bag twice within 3 weeks of purchase. This is a functional failure, not just perception — directly impacts portable use case which is core to the product.
actions.expected_impact: Eliminates primary product quality complaint; removes 'cheap' perception anchor that blocks premium positioning and undermines word-of-mouth recommendations.

actions.action_text: Audit all packaging and advertising claims for '48 hour' longevity; brief legal/regulatory on claim substantiation requirements. Propose revised messaging framework: shift from duration claim to benefit framing (e.g., 'stays with you through your workout').
actions.context_for_team: Customer explicitly called out '48 hour is just a marketing line, koi nahi karta itna last' — actual experience is 6-7 hours. This creates trust erosion and becomes a caveat in recommendations ('smell badhiya hai but reapply karna padega'). Unsubstantiated claims are both a brand risk and regulatory exposure.
actions.expected_impact: Reduces expectation-reality gap that drives disappointment; protects against potential regulatory/advertising standards issues; rebuilds credibility in product claims.

actions.action_text: Add 'Wildstone Office' subtle-scent SKU to Q4 2026 product roadmap discussion. Brief: professional/office context, lighter scent projection, premium packaging, ₹400-500 price point. Request fragrance house to develop 2-3 scent directions.
actions.context_for_team: Customer explicitly segments usage: Wildstone for casual/gym, Nivea for office. Described current scent as 'college boy vibe' inappropriate for meetings. Unprompted willingness to pay ₹400-500 for office variant — this is 60-100% price uplift vs current ₹250 ceiling. Contradiction analysis confirms: 'budget-conscious' framing is category-specific, not absolute.
actions.expected_impact: Opens new premium segment currently lost to Nivea; captures professional use-case revenue; validates premiumization pathway for broader portfolio.

actions.action_text: Conduct competitive audit of Beardo and Bombay Shaving Company Instagram presence; document content formats, posting frequency, influencer partnerships. Present findings + proposed Instagram content strategy to leadership by deadline.
actions.context_for_team: Customer perceives Wildstone as 'old school brand presence' vs competitors who are 'everywhere on Insta'. Direct quote: 'Younger guys are discovering Beardo from reels and influencers. Wildstone needs to up their digital game.' This is a discovery/acquisition gap, not just awareness.
actions.expected_impact: Identifies specific tactical gaps in digital presence; provides foundation for social-first content strategy targeting younger male demographic; reduces competitor advantage in discovery channel.
